map.输入首期现金流 C、贴现率 r、增长率 g、期数 n，求增长年金现值。: Enter first cash flow C, discount rate r, growth rate g and periods n to find the growing-annuity present value.
map.📖 查看「由首期现金流、增长率与贴现率求现值 使用指南」: View "Present Value of a Growing Annuity from First Cash Flow, Growth and Discount Rate User Guide"
map.PV=C÷(r−g)×[1−((1+g)/(1+r))^n]，C 首期现金流、r: PV = C ÷ (r − g) × [1 − ((1+g)/(1+r))^n], where C is the first cash flow, r the discount rate, g the growth rate and n the periods. Requires r > g, otherwise the PV diverges and the formula fails.

map.增长率能超过贴现率吗？: Can the growth rate exceed the discount rate?
map.不能。增长年金公式要求 r>g，否则现值发散、公式失效。若 g≥r 需用永续或其: No. The growing-annuity formula requires r > g, otherwise the PV diverges and the formula fails. If g ≥ r, use a perpetuity or another model with care.
map.和永续增长年金什么关系？: How is it related to the growing perpetuity?
map.有限期 n 的增长年金是永续版 PV=C÷(r−g) 减去第 n 期后的尾值现值: The finite-n growing annuity is the perpetuity PV = C ÷ (r − g) minus the present value of the tail after period n, i.e. the [1 − ((1+g)/(1+r))^n] correction term in the formula.
